paragraphs: Hayden AI mounts cameras on transit buses so cities can catch vehicles that block bus lanes and stops. The system pairs vision AI with hardware built for the vehicle and reads the street around it as the bus drives.

Automated bus lane enforcement is the flagship product, meant to clear unauthorized parking and raise bus speeds. The catalog also lists automated bike lane enforcement. Double parking gets its own product, aimed at a habit the company blames for crashes and lost time on transit routes. The platform is described as identifying objects rather than people.

Cities buy it for outcomes on bus routes, and the company frames the payoff as fewer collisions. Leadership comes from artificial intelligence, data science, transportation, and government technology. The company reports six GovTech 100 wins between 2021 and 2026.

quote.text: Illegal parking or driving in bus lanes delays entire bus routes
